title: The Veil of the Sundered Sea
premise: Twelve years after the Sundering outlawed magic, August Hartwell hides in the port city of Greyhallow as a charm-seller, his swordspeaker's oath buried under silence. When the border wards collapse and the stars extinguish in a single night, he learns the court beneath the mountain has bought the soul of Wren, the wardwright he once loved, to power an endless winter. August breaks his vow of invisibility, gathering a smuggler, a defected court scribe, and his own rusted oath-blade to descend beneath the mountain. In the climax he speaks his true name to unmake the bargain, choosing truth over loyalty to the dead order that bound him, and wins Wren's soul back at the cost of his own magic, ending the long winter as an ordinary man learning to live unhidden.
about_author: Casper Okonkwo is a former maritime archivist who writes fantasy rooted in coastal folklore and the quiet violence of oaths. The Veil of the Sundered Sea is his third novel and the first set in the world of the Sundered Sea.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: August's POV. In Greyhallow, August sells a luck-charm to a dying fisherman, then watches the border wards shatter and the stars vanish overhead. A court scribe named Ivetta finds him and names Wren's soul as the price of the coming winter. The beat is dread: the invisible life he built is over, and the past has come collecting.

chapters.title: What the Oath Remembers
chapters.summary: August's POV, with a flashback to the Sundering. He digs up his rusted oath-blade and bargains passage with the smuggler Brannoc, whose loyalty is bought in secrets. Speaking to the blade for the first time in twelve years, August feels the old power stir and nearly loses himself to it. The beat is temptation: the magic offers strength at the price of the man he has become.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: August and Ivetta's POV alternating. They infiltrate the sunless court and find Wren alive but hollowed, her soul woven into the winter's machinery. The Sundered King offers August his old rank if he abandons her. The beat is the cruelest choice: loyalty to the order that made him versus love for the woman it sold.

chapters.title: A Name Spoken in the Dark
chapters.summary: August's POV. He speaks his true name into the bargain, unbinding Wren's soul and shattering the winter, though the cost strips his magic forever. They climb out beneath a sky where the first stars are relighting. The beat is release: August, ordinary at last, chooses to be seen, and the story closes on the two of them walking toward a thawing sea.
